description: Visual Studio Code helps you edit project files. Learn folders, search, formatting, settings and safe terminal use through a small static-page workspace. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain save and recognise file types

seo.title: VS Code Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn VS Code with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
